mapper.select: SELECT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("book_year", 1, 4)) year, COUNT(*) book_count FROM BOOKMAN."book" GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("book_year", 1, 4)) ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("book_year", 1, 4))
SELECT t."tag_name" tagName, COUNT(*) tagCount FROM BOOKMAN."book_tag" bt LEFT JOIN BOOKMAN."tags" t ON bt."tag_id" = t."tag_id" GROUP BY t."tag_name"
